help.title: Help Center
help.subtitle: Answers to common questions about using FinShield.
help.q1: What does my Risk Score mean?
help.a1: Your score (300–850) and risk band are generated by FinShield's trained machine learning model from the details you provide in the Risk Assessment wizard. It's an indicative estimate of default risk, not a credit decision or financial advice.
help.q2: Why do my Risk Score and Affordability Check sometimes disagree?
help.a2: They measure different things. The Risk Score reflects statistical default-risk patterns learned from credit history, employment, and prior defaults. The Affordability Check is a separate, simpler calculation of whether your current income covers your expenses and EMIs. It's possible to have a low-risk score (no prior defaults, no credit history) while your monthly cash flow is still stretched — both panels are accurate, they just answer different questions.
help.q3: How are Welfare Scheme matches chosen?
help.a3: Each scheme has eligibility rules (income, age, occupation, etc.) that your profile is checked against. Matches link directly to the scheme's official government portal — FinShield never processes an application on your behalf.
help.q4: How do I reset my password?
help.a4Post: and use "Send reset link", or use "Forgot password" on the login page. A reset link is emailed to your account's address and expires after 30 minutes — check your Spam folder if it doesn't arrive.
help.q5: Where can I see my active sessions?
help.a5Post: page to see every device currently signed in to your account, and revoke any you don't recognize.
help.q6: How do I track my daily expenses?
help.a6Post: page to log what you spend each day, see a category breakdown, and download a monthly PDF report.
help.stillText: FinShield doesn't yet have a dedicated support inbox set up. If you were given access to this app by an administrator, reach out to them directly.
